title: Keep a mutable object in a constant binding
summary: Keep the object identity while updating its visit count.
rules: const prevents rebinding, not object mutation.
let and const have block scope and cannot be accessed before initialization.

title: Normalize a numeric form field before comparison
summary: Reject blank and nonnumeric input explicitly, then compare numbers.
rules: Strict equality does not coerce different operand types.
Number of an empty string is zero; validate empty input before conversion.

title: Update a profile without mutating the original
summary: Create a shallow copy with a normalized name. Nested objects still share identity.
syntax:
const object = { key: value, method() {} };
const copy = { ...object, key: replacement };
rules: Object spread copies own enumerable properties shallowly.
Later properties overwrite earlier ones.

title: Separate a task title from its remaining fields
summary: Extract a display value while keeping the other task fields.
syntax:
const { key: local = fallback, ...rest } = object;
const [first, ...remaining] = array;
rules: Defaults apply to undefined, not null.
Rest collects remaining fields or items.

title: Find active task names in a stable order
summary: Filter completed tasks before transforming the remaining items.
rules: map transforms each item; filter selects items.
Supply an initial accumulator to reduce, including for empty arrays.

title: Skip inactive work and stop at a limit
summary: Select at most the requested number of unfinished tasks.
syntax:
if (condition) { statement; } else { statement; }
for (const item of iterable) { statement; }
rules: for...of iterates values; for...in iterates enumerable property keys.
break ends the loop; continue skips its current iteration.

title: Create independent counters with captured state
summary: Each call owns a different count binding.
rules: A closure retains access to lexical bindings after its outer call returns.
Arrow functions inherit this; ordinary functions receive this from their call site.

title: Export a reusable text helper
summary: Import slug from this module; no TypeScript compiler is required.
rules: Named imports use exported names; default imports choose a local name.
Node treats .js as ESM with package type module; .mjs is always ESM.

title: Display an optional profile name
summary: Use the fallback only when the profile or its name is missing.
rules: Optional chaining stops at null or undefined.
Nullish coalescing preserves zero, false and empty strings.

title: Collect successful async results and report failures
summary: Capture synchronous throws from loaders as well as promise rejections.
rules: An async function returns a promise; throws reject it.
all rejects on a failure; allSettled waits for every outcome.

title: Return a useful error when JSON is invalid
summary: Preserve the cause while exposing a task-specific message.
syntax: try { operation(); } catch (error) { recover(error); } finally { cleanup(); }
rules: Throw Error objects to retain a message and stack.
finally runs after success or failure; returning from finally overrides prior results.

title: Format a task using a template expression
summary: Interpolate an expression without concatenation. Use textContent when displaying untrusted text.
rules: Expressions inside ${...} execute as JavaScript.
Template literals preserve literal newlines and do not escape HTML.

title: Count task categories with a Map
summary: Accumulate counts without object prototype-key collisions.
rules: Map keys may be any value and retain insertion order.
Map.get returns undefined for an absent key; has distinguishes stored undefined.

title: Encapsulate a balance with a private class field
summary: Validate deposits before changing private state.
rules: Private fields can only be accessed inside their declaring class.
Methods receive this from the call site; pass a closure when preserving an instance.

title: Attach a click handler and remove it later
summary: Return a cleanup function so the caller can stop observing clicks.
rules: Removal requires the same callback identity and capture setting.
textContent inserts text without interpreting HTML.

title: Cancel a pending JSON request
summary: The caller owns cancellation and must handle result rejection, including AbortError.
rules: fetch rejects on network errors and aborts, not HTTP error statuses.
Check response.ok and pass the signal to fetch; each controller cancels once.

title: Read a UTF-8 file in Node
summary: Read a caller-provided local file; no hardcoded path or external service.
rules: An encoding returns text; omitting it returns a Buffer.
Await filesystem promises and handle failures such as ENOENT.

title: Render a component with props and children
summary: Compose a panel with supplied content rather than calling the component as a normal function.
syntax:
function Component({ label, children }) { return <section>{label}{children}</section>; }
<Component label="Title">content</Component>
rules: Capitalize component names and pass props as attributes.
Children are content nested inside a component; JSX expressions use braces.

title: Read an input from a change handler
summary: Keep input state controlled and type the extracted event handler in TSX.
syntax:
<button onClick={handler}>label</button>
<input onChange={event => read(event.currentTarget.value)} />
rules: Pass a handler function rather than invoking it during render.
currentTarget is the element with the handler; target may be a nested element.

title: Count clicks with a functional state update
summary: Queue an update based on the previous count, with an optional typed label in TSX.
syntax:
const [value, setValue] = useState(initial);
setValue(previous => next);
rules: Call hooks unconditionally at the top level of a component or custom hook.
Use a functional update when the next value depends on the previous state.

title: Render keyed tasks with a conditional empty state
summary: Use fragments, expressions, stable keys and a visible empty state.
syntax:
{items.length ? items.map(item =>
  • {item.name}
    • ) :

    empty

    }
rules: Keys identify siblings across updates; prefer stable IDs over array positions.
Use a boolean condition or ternary; zero with && can render a visible zero.

title: Subscribe to window events with effect cleanup
summary: Subscribe once, remove the same handler on cleanup, and render the measured width.
rules: Effects synchronize with external systems after commit.
Cleanup runs before an effect restarts and on unmount; development StrictMode probes setup and cleanup.

title: Abort a stale request when a component changes
summary: Handle HTTP errors and cancellation without allowing an old request to replace the new result.
rules: Keep the effect callback synchronous and start async work inside it.
Abort obsolete work on cleanup and ignore its outcome before updating state.

title: Focus an input through a DOM ref
summary: Guard the nullable element reference and specify its DOM type in TSX.
rules: Refs persist across renders and changing them does not rerender.
A DOM ref is null before mounting and after unmounting.

title: Validate JSON before accepting a task
summary: Express 5: export the app for local request tests; listen only in the launcher.
rules: Install JSON middleware before routes that consume JSON.
Request bodies are untrusted; validate shape and values.

title: Handle a rejected Express route in error middleware
summary: Keep private error details out of the response; Express 4 requires explicit async forwarding.
rules: Express 5 forwards rejected route promises automatically.
Error middleware has four parameters and goes after routes; delegate when headers are sent.

title: Test a synchronous result and async rejection
summary: Run this file through Vitest; it registers a test rather than executing on import.
rules: Await promise assertions so failures belong to the test.
Test observable behavior and isolate local state between tests.

title: Test a React interaction through its accessible role
summary: Use a DOM test environment (jsdom), React and Testing Library with Vitest.
rules: Query the UI by accessible role and name.
Await user interactions and clean up mounted trees after each test.
